OpenCAD (formerly Hendese CAD) includes @mlightcad/libredwg-web 0.7.15, based on GNU LibreDWG.
Unmodified complete upstream source archive: libredwg-web-v0.7.15-source.zip
Upstream tag: v0.7.15
Commit: 18588818df66d4258b83fda19aa40fd892cdf49d
Repository: https://github.com/mlightcad/libredwg-web
Build instructions: bindings/javascript/README.md in the source archive.
GPLv3 terms are in COPYING in the source archive and ../LICENSE.
All application JavaScript/CSS/HTML source is included in resources/app.

DWG test fixture sources:
https://github.com/LibreDWG/libredwg/tree/master/test/test-data/2000
https://github.com/LibreDWG/libredwg/tree/master/test/test-data/2013
https://github.com/LibreDWG/libredwg/tree/master/test/test-data/2018

Other bundled libraries retain their upstream license files:
- Electron 44.7.0 (MIT and Chromium third-party notices in release root)
- dxf-parser 1.1.2 (MIT)
- loglevel (MIT)

Version 0.2 additions:
- LibreDWG 0.13.4 native Windows x64 dxf2dwg.exe + libredwg-0.dll.
  Corresponding source: libredwg-0.13.4-source.tar.xz.
  Release: https://github.com/LibreDWG/libredwg/releases/tag/0.13.4
  Release ZIP SHA256 cb46bce034296e91cb1a982cd53ec1928b11f4f7f70512dd21513a27959688b5
- Local libredwg-web patch: convertLayer field spelling changed from
  plotflockedlag to locked in dist ES module, UMD and lib/converter.
  This preserves layer locking. All patched source is included.
- pdf-lib 1.17.1 / @pdf-lib/fontkit 1.1.1 retain MIT license files.
- DejaVuSans.ttf redistribution license: fonts/LICENSE.txt.

Version 0.4 local patch:
- lib/converter/entityConverter.js and the used dist/libredwg-web.js ES build:
  getLayerName/getLtypeName use absolute_ref before the encoded handleref value.
  Modified JavaScript sources are bundled. No WASM or native binary modification.
- LibreDWG sample_2000.dwg fixture is copied from the corresponding bundled
  LibreDWG 0.13.4 GPL source test/test-data/sample_2000.dwg.

GitHub source distribution layout:
- Complete upstream source archives are supplied with the full portable OpenCAD.zip
  release under resources/app/third-party/, rather than duplicated in this repository.
- The local converter sources and both used distribution builds are retained under
  vendor/libredwg-web-patches/ and restored after npm installation.
- This repository's application source is at its root (not resources/app).
